desc: The first in a series from BLACK BANANA, these modern instrumental songs with a Hip-Hop / Trap / R&B / Soul sound-set, flavor and street swagger are built on breakbeats from an extensive OCHO study of folkloric Latin rhythms adapted to drum-set.
